1.consolidated_definition: Decir necedades, tonterías. Hablar sobre cosas sin importancia o engañosas. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Es que me creí turista. Eso dicen ¿cuando nos vemos para bullshitear? (MySpace.com, 07-06-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To speak nonsense, trivialities. To talk about unimportant or deceitful things. Anglicism adapted, infrequently used. It's that I thought I was a tourist. That's what they say? When shall we meet to engage in idle chatter?
